steps.title: A name for a sound
steps.body:
**note** means one musical sound. Its **pitch** tells you how high or low it sounds. We name notes with seven letters: A, B, C, D, E, F and G; after G the letters repeat.

**Why it matters:** A name lets you ask for a sound and find it again. You do not need to know a piano keyboard.

steps.title: A, B, then C
steps.body: On string 5, open is A, fret 2 is B and fret 3 is C. Notice that the letter names do not always sit two frets apart. We will measure those gaps next.

items.prompt: Play A2. Use any lit position.
Play B2. Use any lit position.

steps.title: Find two places for A
steps.body: Play the open A string, then fret 5 of string 6. They are the same note, A2; either place counts. Keep your guitar supported.
